title: Climbing Gym Route-Setting Tracker
originalRequest: Audit and establish the weekly route-setting cycle for the main bouldering area, including volume preparation, layout drafting, physical setting, and forerunner testing.
latestMessage: Audit and establish the weekly route-setting cycle for the main bouldering area, including volume preparation, layout drafting, physical setting, and forerunner testing.

steps.title: Verify Zone A hold inventory and structural hardware
steps.instruction: Inspect the physical inventory of high-friction dual-texture holds and M10 bolts required for the upcoming medium-difficulty V4 sets in Zone A, currently on hold due to delayed shipment.
steps.acceptance: All required structural volumes and bolts are accounted for and cleared for safety.

steps.title: Draft setting schematic for Zone B technical slab
steps.instruction: Draft the layout blueprint for a technical slab route using small crimps and volume-dependent foot placement, targeted at a V5 grade, currently paused pending wall surface cleaning.
steps.acceptance: Slab route blueprint is drafted and verified against wall T-nut layout guidelines.

steps.title: Install physical holds for Wave Wall V8 project
steps.instruction: Secure the primary start, finish, and tracking holds for the new high-angle V8 overhang route on the Wave Wall, currently blocked by scissor lift maintenance.
steps.acceptance: All holds are torqued to spec and safety-tested under load.

steps.title: Perform forerunner grading assessment on the V8 overhang
steps.instruction: Execute multiple test runs by at least three qualified setters to confirm movement flow and establish grade consensus, currently blocked by incomplete hold installation.
steps.acceptance: Forerunning feedback forms completed and average grade determined to be within the V8 range.

steps.title: Publish updated wall layout and grades to gym member portal
steps.instruction: Publish the completed routes, grades, and setter notes to the digital tracking board, currently blocked because the forerunner assessments are incomplete.
steps.acceptance: Web portal reflects the updated route distribution and setter assignments for the Wave Wall.
